summary: 50-year-old Arizona man on a guided raft trip with Down Stream Rafting Company died in a rafting accident on Clear Creek (Dumont section, Lawson to Idaho Springs); report at 10:30 a.m. for the 2500 block of Stanley Road, about 2.5 miles northwest of Idaho Springs, CPR already in progress; pronounced dead at the scene at 11:11 a.m.; flush drowning in high water.
location: Clear Creek, Dumont section, near Idaho Springs
notes: Victim unnamed in sources (name withheld pending family notification).
